name: mirage
text:
Version 1.0.135 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.135
It has two fixes. (1) The all-time profit now reads your cash and open bets again if they moved while it was reading, so the number no longer bounces as the engine fills. It also won't swap in an older reading. (2) The +EV tab rebuilds its list once per update instead of twice, which should reduce the freezes. bets.json is not changed. AU1 already delays its writes, so it's still 8 MB but isn't rewritten on every change. I'd like another diagnostics report after you update, so I can see the freezes and the profit figure.
